title: Finite-dimensional algebras, gauge-string duality and thermodynamics
summary: Gauge-invariant polynomial functions of matrix and tensor variables capture combinatorial structures of gauge-string duality, which can be usefully organised using finite-dimensional associative algebras. I review recent work on eigenvalue systems using these algebras as state spaces, which provide efficient computational algorithms for the construction of orthogonal bases in the multi-matrix case. Algebraic counting formulae in matrix and tensor systems with $U(N)$ as well as $S_N$ symmetry have led to gauged quantum mechanical models which display a negative branch of specific heat…
